CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to the identified content.

COD.rationale: Content (red coordinates), an organization/access descriptor (origin) and a separate status-like distinction are all present and bound to the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation statement linking an attention condition or change to the same content's organization/presentation/access.

C.rationale: The text explicitly identifies content (red) with coordinate attributes for the current referent.

D.rationale: The report separately records identified content (red coordinates) and a representation/origin status for the same referent/time.

O.rationale: The text states how the identified content is represented/accessed via an explicit origin field bound to the same referent/time and the content coordinates.
